title: About Company
subtitle: Creating sustainable value through hospitality, lifestyle, and innovation
description:
Bambulogy Group is a hospitality and resort management company that creates unique stays and curated outdoor experiences across Indonesia. We believe travel is not only about a destination but about creating meaningful memories through nature, comfort, and authentic experiences.

Our mission is to develop nature-inspired destinations that combine exceptional hospitality, outdoor adventure, local culture, and sustainable tourism.
mission: To develop nature-inspired destinations that combine exceptional hospitality, outdoor adventure, local culture, and sustainable tourism.
vision: To be a leading steward of sustainable hospitality and lifestyle experiences that balance commercial success with social and environmental responsibility.
